OpenCC runtime assets
=====================

This folder contains the OpenCC conversion engine and dictionaries used by
JianFanConverter at build time. build.ps1 copies these files into dist\; the
finished app also works with this folder deleted, because dist\ contains the
same files.

Source project: https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC
License:        Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE in this folder)

Files:
  opencc.dll          OpenCC C API native library (Windows x64)
  s2t.json            Simplified -> Traditional configuration
  t2s.json            Traditional -> Simplified configuration
  STPhrases.ocd2      Simplified -> Traditional phrase dictionary
  STCharacters.ocd2   Simplified -> Traditional character dictionary
  TSPhrases.ocd2      Traditional -> Simplified phrase dictionary
  TSCharacters.ocd2   Traditional -> Simplified character dictionary

Provenance: these files were taken from the OpenCC distribution bundled with
ConvertZZ v1.0.1.1 (zouhuidong/ConvertZZ, 2025-04-25). They are OpenCC
artifacts and are redistributed here under the Apache License 2.0. No
ConvertZZ source code (GPL-3.0) is included in this project.
